annotations.title: Ask many questions of one document (grounded)

description: Ask many questions of one document (grounded) — Answer up to 12 questions from one context text (up to 15,000 chars) in a single call. questions = JSON array or questions separated by ||. Each answer comes with the exact supporting quote, and every quote is located offline in the context: exact or close (80%+ word overlap) = GROUNDED, weaker = UNVERIFIED, and questions the text cannot answer = NOT_IN_CONTEXT (answer null). Returns a tally and a verdict OK / REVIEW / NO_ANSWERS. Good for form filling, due diligence checklists and RAG evaluation. Workers AI (Llama 3.3 70B). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

context.description: e.g. Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Shipping costs $5 for orders under $50 and is free above that. Support is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern.

questions.description: e.g. How long is the refund window?||How much is shipping on a $30 order?||Who is the CEO?
